identitySignals: Agenda names 'American Institutes for Research (AIR)' in Arlington, VA; ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer lists 'American Institutes For Research In The Behavioral Sciences' in Arlington, VA (EIN 25-0965219), and AIR's contact page gives 1400 Crystal Drive, Arlington, VA

AIR describes itself as a nonprofit that conducts behavioral and social science research and technical assistance in education, matching an OUSD Research, Assessment, and Data Department data-sharing agreement
AIR has published research studies involving Oakland Unified School District (fiscal study of charter and district schools in Oakland)
